title.rendered: Progress Video – New High School Site – 12/22/2019

content.rendered: Please view the most recent aerial video of the progress made at the new high school site, taken on December 22, 2019. The past week’s work included: installing of walk-in freezers and coolers, blackout paint applied in the theater, football stadium goal posts installed, as well as pouring of retaining wall footings in the courtyard.
